notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM also holds Ford Motor Co and Ford Motor Credit Co LLC bonds, in separate rows that are not counted. CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS holds Common Stock; the denominator is Common Stock plus Class B Stock at October 26, 2026 (Q3 2026 10-Q cover), the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: Common Stock only; Class B Stock has 4 holders of record.
